packages.section: Part C §8 "P3-int" (the F4 showcase, the long take, the combat-log feel toggle) as amended by Part A §A23, plus the slice gate's gaps 10 and 12 and G1's gap 1 (docs/milestones/M4-slice-gate.md) and F-motion's two HumanoidRig requests (docs/milestones/M4-calls/F-motion.md)
packages.note: You own game/ui/cheat_menu.gd, game/ui/combat_log_overlay.gd, game/ui/help_overlay.gd, game/actors/humanoid_rig.gd (only for steps 4 and 5), tests/bot/acts/look_acts.gd and tests/test_look_acts.gd, tests/test_art_punk.gd (only for step 6), any new script your showcase needs under game/debug/ (or wherever the cheat menu's helpers live), new tests for all of it, the Look > FP feel subgroup in tuning_data.gd (fp_knockdown_hide_torso is already there: leave it; P3-int proper wires it), and docs/milestones/M4-calls/P3-early.md. Every feel toggle defaults to today's behaviour. Steps: (1) 'Look: Punk at 1 m, the long take' in look_acts.gd: one 40 s first-person clip of one Punk at 1 m in the crowd room, scripted (rig.play, play_locomotion, play_move, force_attack; AI-driven motion at 1 m sits in RECOVER): idle, a turntable, walk in, taunt, jab and cross, takes a jab, stagger, knockdown, get-up, KO. Put the script in one place so step 2 reuses it. (2) F4 'Showcase Punk at 1 m' in cheat_menu.gd: a frozen Punk 1 m ahead looping the long take's script, so Game-boy can walk round it in the game (Freeze AI alone shows only an idle). It must leave the game exactly as it was when switched off (the Punk freed, the AI and the director as before) and work in both rooms. (3) Feel question 4 (grab-03, the combat log over the knee): a log toggle key listed in the help overlay, and combat_log_hide_while_holding (false) in Look > FP feel: while you hold an enemy the log hides. Both default to today. (4) F-motion's request: rebuild HumanoidRig's named libraries when a Motion tunable, move_speed or look_motion_polish changes (Tuning.changed), so the F1 sliders are live; rigs already built pick up the new library without a pop. (5) F-motion's request: start each rig's looped idle at its own phase, so a wave spawned in one frame doesn't breathe and bounce in step. Make it deterministic (from the actor's spawn order or id, never a random number generator), and log any test that depended on phase 0, old -> new with a twin. (6) Gate gap 10: in test_art_punk, a SkeletonModifier3D after Ragdoll on a real StreetPunk (punk.glb) through jab, stagger, launch, get-up and KO, asserting the skeleton equals the followers within 1 mm on every update. (7) Gate gap 12: add a face-down knockdown, downed_front and getup_front at 1-2 m to the evidence acts (C5 or the long take). (8) G1's gap 1: a windowed L5 evidence act that prints R4 and R8 with the art drawn beside the proxies' figures for 'Six Punks, fight' and 'Mixed six, fight', skinning ragdolling rigs through SkinnedView.drawn_pose. The title must not contain or be contained in another act's title, and test_look_acts.gd pins the new slugs. Record the long take, the showcase (a short windowed recording with F4 on) and the L5 act, look at them in first person, and say honestly how the Punk reads in the long take at 1 m.
